papers.title: Spectrum Adaptation of AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
papers.abstract: End-to-end physical-layer learning replaces separate modulation, coding, and detection operations with an autoencoder (AE) that consists of a jointly trained encoder-decoder pair at the transmitter and the receiver. This paper studies AI-native communications with AEs and quantifies the sensitivity to training-test mismatch in channel models. Models trained only on an AWGN channel achieve low bit error rates (BERs) under matched conditions but degrade severely on Rayleigh fading with practical front-end impairments. To reduce the time and energy required to adapt to new channel conditions, we propose a low-latency transfer-learning procedure that starts from an AWGN-pretrained system and fine-tunes only a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers while freezing the remainder. We further formulate layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem that identifies the most informative parameters to update during adaptation. This preserves the learned signal geometry and the deep decision structure while adapting lightweight front ends to fading- and impairment-induced mixing. For AE communications, we show that partial updates remove the mismatch-induced error floor and approach the BER of fully retrained models. We provide a layer-wise study and quantify resource-performance trade-offs, showing that modest adaptation substantially reduces BER while cutting training time, multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations, energy consumption, and the fraction of updated parameters for resource-efficient implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 端到端自编码器通信在AWGN下表现良好，但训练与测试信道失配（如瑞利衰落和前端损伤）会导致严重性能下降。本文提出一种低延迟迁移学习方法，从AWGN预训练模型出发，仅微调少量收发层并冻结其余层，同时将层选择建模为预算约束优化问题以挑选最有信息量的参数。实验表明部分更新可消除失配引起的误码率底限并接近全量重训性能，同时显著降低训练时间、MAC运算、能耗和更新参数比例。
papers.summary_en: End-to-end autoencoder communications trained on AWGN suffer severe degradation under channel mismatch such as Rayleigh fading with practical front-end impairments. This paper proposes a low-latency transfer-learning procedure that fine-tunes only a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers from an AWGN-pretrained model while freezing the rest, formulating layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem to identify the most informative parameters. Results show that partial updates remove the mismatch-induced error floor and approach fully retrained BER while substantially cutting training time, MAC operations, energy consumption, and the fraction of updated parameters.
highlights_zh: 预算约束下选择性微调少量层
部分更新消除误码率底限近全量重训
大幅降低训练时间与能耗，限于信道适配

papers.title: Attack Policy Selection can Mislead Monitor Evaluators
papers.abstract: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. We evaluate an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study and find that measured false negative rate is highly sensitive to both the method used to generate attack policies and the level of optimisation applied within that method. This rate ranged from 0.5\% to 20.8\% across optimisation levels of a single method (reinforcement learning), and from 6.4\% to 23.0\% across methods at their best observed optimisation level (optimised prompting vs.\ transcript editing). Every attack policy was developed against proxy monitors only: all reported results show attacks transferring to the held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Our results suggest that monitor evasion evaluations can easily mislead: an evaluation using only basic attack methods may give false confidence that a monitor is strong. The sensitivity to attack-policy choice raises a problem: interpreting any particular result as evidence about deployment performance requires justification. The transcripts produced by attack policies are proxies for the dangerous behaviour a monitor must flag in deployment. These proxies can introduce visible artefacts, such as reasoning about a ``side task'' absent from the instructions shown to the monitor, that affect monitor judgements. Given the sensitivity above, the choice of proxy can change an evaluation's conclusion. Reading these results as evidence about deployment therefore requires a separate legitimacy argument for why the proxies are informative, including any justification of conservativeness. Making convincing arguments remains an open problem.
papers.summary_zh: AI监控器常被用来标记AI智能体的危险行为，其评估依赖攻击策略生成的对话记录作为危险行为的代理，但这些代理是否可靠尚不清楚。作者以一款已投产的OpenAI监控器为案例，系统比较了不同攻击策略生成方法（强化学习、优化提示、对话记录编辑）及不同优化水平下测得的漏报率。结果显示漏报率在单一强化学习方法内随优化水平从0.5%波动到20.8%，不同方法间从6.4%到23.0%，说明仅用基础攻击方法评估会高估监控器强度，将评估结果解读为部署性能证据需要额外的合法性论证。
papers.summary_en: AI monitors that flag dangerous agent behaviour are typically evaluated on transcripts produced by attack policies used as proxies for deployment-time dangerous behaviour, but the validity of these proxies is unclear. Using an ex-production OpenAI monitor as a case study, the authors systematically vary attack-policy generation methods (reinforcement learning, optimised prompting, transcript editing) and optimisation levels, measuring false negative rates against a held-out GPT-5.4 target monitor. Measured false negative rate ranged from 0.5% to 20.8% across optimisation levels of a single RL method and from 6.4% to 23.0% across methods at their best observed level, showing that evaluations using only basic attacks can give false confidence and that interpreting any result as deployment evidence requires a separate legitimacy argument for the proxies.
highlights_zh: 揭示监控器评估对攻击策略选择高度敏感
代理合法性论证仍是开放问题
highlights_en: Shows monitor evasion evals are highly sensitive to attack-policy choice
FNR spans 0.5%-20.8% across optimisation levels, 6.4%-23.0% across methods
Legitimacy argument for proxies remains an open problem

papers.title: Tokenisation is not in APX
papers.abstract: In this paper, we prove that, unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can find a tokeniser whose objective is within any constant factor of the optimum, meaning that tokenisation is not in the APX complexity class. We prove this for direct and bottom-up tokenisation, under both a compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, and for binary or larger alphabets. We further show that, even over unary alphabets, direct tokenisation is APX-hard, and thus admits no polynomial-time approximation scheme.
papers.summary_zh: 分词器优化是子词分词的核心问题，其计算复杂度此前尚未明确。本文通过归约证明，在压缩或一元对数似然目标下，对直接式和自底向上分词、二元及更大字母表，除非P=NP否则不存在常数因子近似算法。结果表明分词问题不属于APX类，且一元字母表下直接分词为APX-hard，不存在多项式时间近似方案，为分词算法设计划定了理论边界。
papers.summary_en: Optimizing tokenisers is a central problem in subword tokenisation whose computational complexity was previously unresolved. Using reductions, this paper proves that unless P=NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can achieve any constant-factor approximation for direct and bottom-up tokenisation under compression or unigram log-likelihood objectives, for binary or larger alphabets. The results show tokenisation is not in APX, and direct tokenisation is APX-hard even over unary alphabets, admitting no polynomial-time approximation scheme, thereby establishing theoretical limits for tokeniser design.
highlights_zh: 证明分词问题不属于APX类
常数因子近似不可行（除非P=NP）
为分词算法设计划定理论边界

papers.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
papers.abstract: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.
papers.summary_zh: 语言模型用文字思考，多模态模型能否用图像辅助视觉推理尚不明确。本文让模型先描述所需辅助图像，再结合原图与生成图像共同回答视觉问题，并在13组视觉语言模型与生成器组合上系统评测。结果显示生成图像平均降低准确率3.7个百分点，十个任务中九个下降，表明当前图像生成对视觉推理多为干扰而非帮助。
papers.summary_en: Whether multimodal models can think in images to aid visual reasoning remains unclear. The authors let a model describe a helper image it needs, then answer visual questions using the original and generated images together, evaluating 13 vision-language model and generator pairs. Generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks, indicating that current image generation mostly distracts rather than helps visual reasoning.
highlights_zh: 模型自述所需辅助图并联合原图作答
平均准确率降3.7个百分点，九成任务下降
统一模型亦受损，生成辅助尚不实用

papers.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
papers.abstract: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT
papers.summary_zh: 循环Transformer通过跨循环复用共享层提升表达能力，但效率受损，亟需重新思考相邻循环间应传递什么。本文提出Mixture-of-Loops Transformer（MoLT），其MoLA以键值作为跨深度与循环选择性复用的记忆，并衍生MoLT-R、MoLT-KV及U-MoLT变体，配合loop forcing实现单遍历解码。在400B token预训练中U-MoLT在700M/1.5B稠密与3B MoE上超越OLMo3，700M取得1.7倍验证CE token效率，3B MoE困惑度降0.75、准确率升2.1个百分点，推理延迟与无循环基线相当。
papers.summary_en: Looped Transformers improve expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops but sacrifice efficiency, calling for a rethink of what should be passed between adjacent loops. We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) treats keys and values as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops, yielding MoLT-R, MoLT-KV, and U-shaped MoLT variants, with loop forcing enabling single-traversal decoding. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation CE token efficiency at 700M and improving 3B MoE perplexity by 0.75 and accuracy by 2.1 points, while matching non-looped latency at inference.
highlights_zh: 以KV作为跨循环选择性复用记忆
700M达1.7倍CE token效率
推理延迟与无循环基线相当

papers.title: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
papers.abstract: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.
papers.summary_zh: 相机控制的视频生成在围绕物体移动视角时仍很困难，因为相机参数在单目视频中存在尺度歧义，而显式几何（如变形点云或深度）在大视角变化下会失效。AnyCam 用场景中的锚定物体来表示相机：先对该物体进行三维重建并沿目标轨迹渲染，得到尺度感知、视角完整且易于指定的相机信号，再由视频扩散模型将源视频的内容与动态迁移到新视角，其 H-Concat 布局在时间上对齐源帧与目标帧，并可蒸馏为流式少步生成器 AnyCam-AR。在多数据集与轨迹上的实验表明，AnyCam 在相机控制与视觉质量上优于相机控制视频生成与三维重建方法。
papers.summary_en: Camera-controlled video generation still struggles to move the camera around an object, since camera parameters are scale-ambiguous in monocular video and explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth breaks down under large viewpoint changes. AnyCam represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: it reconstructs the object in 3D and renders it along the target trajectory, yielding a scale-aware, view-complete and easy-to-specify camera signal, and a video diffusion model transfers the source video's content and dynamics to the new viewpoint, with an H-Concat layout that aligns source and target frames in time and enables distillation into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.
highlights_zh: 以锚定物体三维渲染表示相机信号
相机控制与视觉质量优于现有方法
可用于流式实时相机控制生成

papers.title: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.
papers.summary_zh: 点对应任务要求跨观测像素级定位同一物理表面点，对VLM而言因超出物体级识别而颇具挑战。本文提出AgenTAP，一个基于VLM的智能体，直接预测点坐标与可见性，并从自身估计出发自主选择检查区域、利用证据验证点身份并精化预测。借助GPT-6 Astra，它在无需对应任务微调的情况下于点定位和可见性预测上超越专家视觉模型，并用于构建EgoTAP-4D长时第一人称3D点轨迹数据集，提升3D跟踪性能。
papers.summary_en: Point correspondence requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, which is challenging for VLMs as it goes beyond object-level recognition. We introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos, autonomously choosing what to inspect and using evidence to verify point identity and refine predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in point localization and visibility prediction without correspondence-specific fine-tuning, and is used to build EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long egocentric videos that improves 3D tracking when added to D4RT training.
highlights_zh: VLM智能体自主推理验证点身份
无需微调即超越专家视觉模型
构建EgoTAP-4D提升3D跟踪

papers.title: DexLink: Synthesizing Dexterous Behaviors from Chained Hand-object Poses
papers.abstract: Synthesizing diverse dexterous manipulation policies is challenging: existing simulation-based approaches rely on human demonstrations which are difficult to scale, or use generic reward functions, which provide limited control over the hand-object interactions. We propose DexLink, which addresses these limitations by synthesizing diverse dexterous behaviors from sparse, reusable hand-object interaction templates. Given key task waypoints, DexLink retargets static interaction templates to target objects using an optimization that preserves spatial hand-object relationships. It then links the retargeted poses into an approximate reference trajectory and uses residual reinforcement learning to refine this reference into a closed-loop policy in simulation. Experiments spanning single-hand, bimanual, articulated, and dynamic tasks demonstrate that DexLink provides fine-grained control over task timing, grasp types, and high-level execution. The modular interaction templates transfer reliably across object scales, instances, and categories; without object-specific human demonstrations, the framework also matches the performance of dense reference-tracking methods. Finally, zero-shot deployment of policies trained purely in simulation shows promise for the simulation-based framework.
papers.summary_zh: 现有基于仿真的灵巧操作策略合成方法依赖难以扩展的人类演示或控制力有限的通用奖励函数。DexLink通过将稀疏可复用的手-物交互模板重定向到目标物体、链接为近似参考轨迹并用残差强化学习精炼为闭环策略来解决这一问题。实验表明该方法在单手、双手、关节体和动态任务中提供细粒度控制，模板可跨物体尺度与类别迁移，无需物体特定人类演示即可匹配密集参考跟踪方法，并展现出仿真训练策略零样本部署的潜力。
papers.summary_en: Existing simulation-based approaches for synthesizing dexterous manipulation policies rely on human demonstrations that are hard to scale or generic reward functions that offer limited control over hand-object interactions. DexLink addresses these limitations by retargeting sparse, reusable hand-object interaction templates to target objects, linking them into an approximate reference trajectory, and refining it via residual reinforcement learning into a closed-loop policy. Experiments across single-hand, bimanual, articulated, and dynamic tasks show fine-grained control over timing and grasp types, reliable template transfer across object scales and categories, performance matching dense reference-tracking methods without object-specific demonstrations, and promise for zero-shot deployment of simulation-trained policies.
highlights_zh: 稀疏交互模板重定向+残差强化学习
无需物体特定演示即匹配密集跟踪方法
仿真策略零样本部署初显潜力

papers.title: MERLoc: Robust Robot Localization in Dynamic Environments with Pose-Based Retrieval over 3D Gaussian Splatting References
papers.abstract: Robots operating in previously mapped spaces must localize accurately despite moving people and rearranged objects. Most localization pipelines match the query against a sparse set of captured reference images retrieved by appearance, which is brittle under scene change and repeating structures. We present MERLoc, which turns a single metric 3D Gaussian Splatting scan into a dense Functional Reference Memory. Reference views are sampled over the navigable space for the robot's morphology and sensors at a target density and rendered offline. Pre-encoding them for the chosen off-the-shelf localizer removes the reference encoder from inference. A pose-based retrieval strategy then selects references by spatial proximity and viewing direction rather than appearance, sidestepping visual ambiguities whenever a prior exists. Across one classical and four learned localizers in simulated and real dynamic scenes, pose-based retrieval matches or outperforms appearance retrieval in most cases, even when the latter is gated by the same prior. On real data, it lowers position RMSE by 15-60 % in nine of ten backend/split combinations, and the rendered memory outperforms real-image caches posed by Structure-from-Motion. The system runs onboard a Jetson Orin NX at 5 Hz, enabling a navigation policy to successfully traverse a hallway with people roaming and rearranging objects.
papers.summary_zh: 机器人在已建图空间中需在行人和物体移动时准确定位，但主流方法依赖外观检索稀疏参考图，在场景变化和重复结构下易失效。MERLoc将单次3D高斯泼溅扫描转为稠密功能参考记忆，按机器人形态与传感器在可导航空间离线采样并预编码参考视图，再用基于位姿的空间邻近与视角检索替代外观检索。在仿真与真实动态场景中，该方法在多数情况下匹配或超越外观检索，真实数据上九成组合位置RMSE降低15-60%，并可在Jetson Orin NX上以5Hz运行支持导航。
papers.summary_en: Robots localizing in previously mapped spaces must remain accurate despite moving people and rearranged objects, yet most pipelines match queries against sparse appearance-retrieved reference images that are brittle under scene change and repetition. MERLoc converts a single metric 3D Gaussian Splatting scan into a dense Functional Reference Memory by sampling and offline-rendering reference views over navigable space for the robot's morphology and sensors, pre-encoding them so the reference encoder is removed from inference, and retrieving by spatial proximity and viewing direction instead of appearance. Across one classical and four learned localizers in simulated and real dynamic scenes, pose-based retrieval matches or outperforms appearance retrieval in most cases, lowers position RMSE by 15-60% in nine of ten real backend/split combinations, and runs onboard a Jetson Orin NX at 5 Hz to enable successful navigation through a crowded, rearranged hallway.
highlights_zh: 位姿检索替代外观检索
真实数据RMSE降15-60%
Jetson上5Hz实时运行

papers.title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
papers.abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.
papers.summary_zh: 对LLM数学推理进行后训练通常依赖最终答案通过验证器的被接受推理轨迹，但在难题上独立蒙特卡洛采样很难得到这样的轨迹。作者提出DART，从被拒绝的轨迹出发，将其分解为推理步骤并按位置加权不确定性排序，再借助参考答案引导和元思考为高排名步骤生成刻意不同的替代候选，并补全轨迹。在DeepMath-103K贪心未解问题上，DART在相同生成轨迹数下比MC采样多恢复37%的问题，每个被接受轨迹的成本低30%，用其挖掘轨迹后训练Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在六项评测中的五项取得最高点估计。
papers.summary_en: Post-training LLMs for mathematical reasoning typically relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier, but such traces are rare under independent Monte Carlo sampling on hard problems. The authors propose DART, which starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty, and generates deliberately distinct alternatives for top-ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces with nearly identical cost per recovered problem and 30% lower cost per accepted trace, and post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on DART-mined traces achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME.
highlights_zh: 从被拒轨迹挖掘多样化替代推理路径
同预算下多恢复37%难题，接受轨迹成本降30%
可扩展后训练数据，但依赖参考答案引导
